constraints: Implement the approved IDR verify-phase-vocabulary (cycles/CYC-0095/decisions/05d6166d878b412b898ed9e35b578db9.json, sha256 95f7aa80937ad243686a736ccfe18782c55405416fb51417159f3357f4989a29, approved by council record cycles/CYC-0095/councils/decisions/8171443aa89fcdf82c9f467b/council-e4304ea1b1874cd1bd8237b81dd491c9.json); a material change to it needs a new revision and fresh council approval before dependent work.
New records carry phase_names "verify"; a record without the key keeps the historical names, with 'test' after Build.
No committed cycle record under bionic/cycles/ is rewritten; load, validate, inspect, render and upgrade add no key and change no stored phase.
schema_version stays 3; upgrade adds only v3_fields(), never phase_names.
A record without phase_names keeps its review basis digests unchanged, so a stored review still binds.
Plan and task-add input accepts 'test' and 'verify' and stores the record's own name.
The release step id stays 'verify' and tools/release.py verify keeps its name and behavior; only the description text of a new beta list's verify step changes.
Instructions write 'the Verify phase' for the phase and 'the release verify step' or 'release.py verify' for the release step, never a bare 'verify'.
Every dashboard phase table that names 'test' also names 'verify', and Verify draws in Test's colour key.
Historical surfaces keep their text: released CHANGELOG sections, promptbook templates, ADR bodies, journal entries, cycle records and review reports.

Generated outputs are regenerated by their regenerators, never hand-edited: micro-crux (crux/box and root preview), opencode/agents/, crux/catalog/skills.json, the routing-table regions, crux/catalog/rules.json if a cited rule changes, and the bionic/arch spine (its data model reads crux/schemas/cycle.schema.json).
bionic/objectives.md is not edited: the OBJ-7 measure wording is an owner decision.
No ADR file, lifecycle or authority metadata changes, and crux-authority-reset.md is not edited by this cycle's agents; candidates go to the commander.
Changes to crux-mods/hooks/lib/ need the cycle's independent review; they also owe a live OpenCode 2 check from the beta install before the next official release.
CYC-0095 runs on the installed 5.0.1 engine as a historical-vocabulary record: its tasks use phase 'test'.
